answer: The signal counter is kept in saffron and dawn reveals each reset. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 38 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
